data.one_liner: An animated circular countdown timer widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable circular countdown timer widget supporting forward and reverse countdowns, gradients, custom text formatting, and full control over timer states via a controller.
use_when: You need a circular timer or countdown display in your UI
You require start, pause, resume, restart, and reset controls for a countdown timer
avoid_when: You need a linear or text-only countdown without any circular representation
You require background audio or push notification alarms tied strictly to the timer
strengths: Supports both forward and reverse countdowns and animations
Includes a rich set of styling parameters like gradients and stroke customization
Provides a controller for programmatic control (start, pause, resume, restart, reset)
weaknesses: Not documented for complex multi-timer orchestration out of the box
data.minimal_example:
CircularCountDownTimer(
    duration: 10,
    initialDuration: 0,
    controller: CountDownController(),
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    ringColor: Colors.grey,
    fillColor: Colors.purpleAccent,
    strokeWidth: 20.0,
    textStyle: TextStyle(fontSize: 33.0, color: Colors.white, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
    isReverse: false,
    autoStart: false,
)
